milestones.title: Codex vertical slice and fleet
milestones.decision: Codex implementation is Intermediate, with discovery, safety correction, implementation, and service-transition evidence recorded. The first corrective rollover preserved the completed 6bfa69dc13cc9e1ded9c6baa6e803cb99bc8c20b transition, and the required rerun activated exact revision 063445154bca0bf5ec43db94ba57c17fd193fd99 with real systemd, HTTP, authenticated-browser, Registry, and rollback proof. AUTO-M5-OWNER-OUTCOMES then passed for that service with four total outcomes: three verified and one owner-unavailable. A real quota-history regression was Red because a latest complete one-window collection left one prior-run window in the public current set. The owner approved focused plan 1.5.0; its complete-scope lifecycle correction passed all 71 Capacity tests, its exact second-rollover implementation passed all 43 activation tests, and the module boundary check is clean. The first live second-rollover attempt blocked before mutation because the rebooted same-revision service had a later PID/start generation than its immutable activation receipt; the frozen policy node went Red and the narrow restart-generation correction returned all 43 activation tests to Green. The corrected live rollover/activation, fresh corrected-service collection, refreshed owner prerequisites, required quota, process, alert, and containment evidence, clean exact-revision AUTO-M5-EXIT run, and owner acceptance remain Not Run or Blocked as recorded. The canonical gate state remains not_run.
